[WP] "Well, this is disappointing" - said the first man on Mars

Sitting up in his bed, Sven stared through the inch-thick plexiglass and out there in the reddish brown desert under a reddish brown sky, zoning out until his eyes could no longer register the occasional rocks. He wondered if it was worth it to accept coming here. He bought the lottery ticket to "Be The 1st Man in Mars" as a half-assed donation to the space programs. It was also to assert his bragging right as that crazy amateur explorer version of "been there, done that" in front of his drunk friends. As a joke, of course, since he didn't actually expected to win, and in his opinion, having your name mentioned in a paragraph, maybe with a picture, in a textbook for some future kids to drool over in their future desks, which would probably look like today's desk, was pretty goddamn worthless.

Apparently there was a trillionaire who offered a lot of money to claim such a "momentous honor" for his grandson. The executive boards in charge of the fledgling colony research program thought it would be even more lucrative to instead set up a public lottery. Turned into a whole damnable, shady mess that Sven did not even pay attention to in the news until everyone panicked when the winner was nowhere to be found for a week because he was spelunking at some cave in India that nobody with a computer heard of.

Even if Sven didn't care in the beginning, he just couldn't not care about something so astronomical improbable, especially when it was something everyone gave plenty shit about, especially the trillionaire. The thing that must have been absolutely maddening to the rich grandpa was that Sven could not get a lot of money, but he couldn't sell it low enough either.

Having a lot of money is pretty fucking dangerous and depressing to a guy who loves to travel alone because you just can't relax when anyone offers you a beer or a bed, and Sven's face was broadcasted across the world until some genius got the idea of talking with the local kids. Selling it for the small max amount that Sven would have wanted was also out of the question because people would ask why on god-forsaken Earth would he sell something worth more than a thousand Jackpots for a hundred grand until he kill himself. Lying about how much money he got paid also wasn't an option because then people would assume he had money to spare for ransom, which goes right back to the first problem.

He wished that identity-tag security wasn't so great

So in the end, Sven pretty much had no fucking option except to keep the damn ticket, and he was pretty sure his life was threatened at some point and now had to live in Mars forever. Not forever, but pretty much forever if he wanted to be where even the trillionaire's arsenal of revenge couldn't reach.

He rolled his head, letting out muffled cracking and tapped his finger against his knees. Suddenly, the door opened with more speed than usual, causing him to jump a little. Sven swiveled toward the woman who just entered his room, letting his feet touch the floor. He recognized her not by her face but her irritated look, a directed attitude out of something about the person who got to be one of the "first person on Mars" happening to be someone who just didn't give a shit. Her name was Ava.

Ava threw a thin, rectangular block with circuitry drawn on its logo at Sven, which he caught with one hand. Upon examination, he saw that it had a sticker "PS01 - ENMT #0069". He glanced at Ava who was crossing her arms, her face demanding an explanation.

"Thanks for bringing this over, I guess." said Sven as he shook the 10 terabyte SSD unit in his hand.

Ava pinched the bridge of her nose and kept her voice low. "As part of cybersecurity, I had to look through things, alien tentacle porn just being one of those things. Why didn't you just submit a form?"

"Because what's the point in ensuring digital privacy in our society if I, a private individual and not a government employee, have to file a report to the government what's in here? Also, that one wasn't mine. Your associates," Sven said, quoting with his hands. "are also involved in this."

Ava's hand slid to cover her face. "Was that Kenji?"

"No, it was Sung-Ha. You're kind of being racist with the whole if tentacles then obviously the Japanese dude." Sven said, keeping his smile off his face. It was definitely Kenji; Sung-Ha had claims on all the Overwatch porn. "Aren't you like a quarter Japanese?"

Her jaws clenched, which told Sven that Ava really wanted to correct him, but knew it would change the subject.

Sven held his flat hands together as if to make a deal. "Just so you know, Those things does include two-guy action stuff. Maybe we can come to a compromise?"

Ava snorted, but with a smile. "Now who's being racist?"

"Hey, being attracted to homo action of the opposite sex is universal in all cultures." said Sven as he laid his hand on himself. "Though your people do have a word for it that is used world-wide."

Ava clenched her jaw again. She sighed. "Well it doesn't matter anymore. It's wiped." She leaned close to Sven, giving him a wicked grin. "Turns out it had viruses."

Ava turned and left the room, opening and closing the door more softly than she had when she entered. Sven held a strained, straight face and looked out the window again, holding the box in his hands.

"Well, this is disappointing."
